name: lane-belt-balancer
title: Belt Balancer Planner
author: lane-belt-balancer
description: Select a gap between input belt ends and output belt starts; the mod picks a belt or lane balancer that fits, routes the belts to it and places ghosts. Supports 1-4 inputs to 1-4 outputs (except 4 to 3) and a 1 to 1 lane balancer.
